If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 2-3 vs Kalulu FC | You: 7.6
push.body:
A 7.6, PhogsToffees. The scoreboard says meh. I say we're one tweak away.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Kalulu FC's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 4. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Proof you've got another gear.
+ On-ball actions 48, up from your usual 40. Gold star, no notes.
+ 3 goals conceded added +0.1. Quiet contributions count.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Coach's tip: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.
- 68% passing (25 of 37, down from your usual 80%). Game plan: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. Rome, day by day.
- Missed tackles 6, up from your usual 3. Let's not make that a pattern.
- 0.4 below usual. Every streak has a hiccup.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. Note to self, from me to you.

Homework: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Hey, PhogsToffees. There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

Every great story has a slow chapter. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs Kalulu FC | You: 7.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.5 for a forward. A little under, a little lesson, a lot of upside.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 20 attempts, up from your usual 76%. Your passes were cleaner than a Sunday shirt.
+ 3 shots at Kalulu FC's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ 4th straight match at 7.5 match rating. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ 3 goals conceded: +0.1. Coach likes this one.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 20, down from your usual 30. Little adjustment: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 0.3 below average. The fight's still in you; I saw it.
- 1 tackle won cost you 0.1. Next match, keep it simple.
- Shots on target: 67%. One gear up gets you to 90%+.
- Key passes: 1. Top-quarter forwards live at 2+. Let's move in.

Practice this: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Brick by brick. - Coach Lasso
